subject: Decision: AFE v1 ships global masking only
body:
Team,

Decision: v1 ships with global masking only. A 3.2% and 1.8% lift with a simple serving story beats a bigger win we can't operate. Local masks go on the Q3 roadmap as "AFE segments", already in the locked OKRs as a stretch item.

Launch review is set for 8/4. What I need before then:
- Rosa: serving-path writeup, including why per-segment pipelines were cut.
- Giannis: leaderboard service demo - both alpha partners' tasks live on it, with significance tests visible. It demos really well and I want it front and center in the review.
- Linnea/Yusuf: one-pager on the masking method for the appendix.

Small thing but pls double-check the airbnb benchmark numbers against the rerun before they go in the deck.

Anders
